business_summary: Dasheng Times Cultural Investment Co., Ltd. engages in the research, development, distribution, and operation of interactive entertainment products. It is also involved in the creation, intelligent production, full-process post-production, and multi-channel distribution of content such as films, television dramas, online platform dramas, and short dramas, as well as games. The company was formerly known as Baocheng Investment Co., Ltd. and changed its name to Dasheng Times Cultural Investment Co., Ltd. in June 2016. Dasheng Times Cultural Investment Co., Ltd. was founded in 1993 and is based in Shenzhen, China.
business_summary_ko: Dasheng Times Cultural Investment Co., Ltd.는 인터랙티브 엔터테인먼트 제품의 연구, 개발, 유통 및 운영에 종사하고 있습니다. 또한 게임은 물론 영화, TV 드라마, 온라인 플랫폼 드라마, 단편 드라마 등 콘텐츠의 창작, 지능형 제작, 전 과정 후반 작업, 다채널 배급에도 참여하고 있습니다. 회사는 이전에 Baocheng Investment Co., Ltd.로 알려졌으며 2016년 6월에 Dasheng Times Cultural Investment Co., Ltd.로 이름을 변경했습니다. Dasheng Times Cultural Investment Co., Ltd.는 1993년에 설립되었으며 중국 심천에 본사를 두고 있습니다.
